summary.text: Stephen L. Goldfinch is a Republican member of the South Carolina Senate for District 34, which covers Georgetown and Horry Counties.
He is an attorney and previously served in the S.C. House from 2013 to 2016.

paragraphs.text: Goldfinch was born on November 19, 1982, in Conway.
His official page lists a B.S. from The Citadel in 2004, an M.B.A. in 2006, and a J.D. from Charleston School of Law in 2010.
He served in the S.C. House of Representatives from 2013 to 2016.
His Senate committees are Agriculture and Natural Resources, Finance, Fish, Game and Forestry, and Rules.
